name: Trolling Slap Tower 🖐️
desc:
Welcome to Trolling Slap Tower 🖐️!

Get ready for nonstop fun as you climb the tower or get knocked down! Will you make it to the top while avoiding the trolls, or become the one causing the chaos?

Use your slap hand, outplay the others, and see how far you can go before someone stops you!

Who will rise, and who will fall?

[TAGS]: Slap Game, Troll Game, Tower Climb, Funny Game, Slap Battle, Ragdoll Physics, Multiplayer, Meme Game, PvP, Slap Attack, Chaos, Obstacle Tower, Roblox Funny, Fast Paced, Knockback
